_about: The one extra detail of how a drafted character looks, rolled by dramatis/looks.py so the Appearance never falls back on the model's own favourite (three drafts in a row came back with a chickenpox scar above the left eyebrow). Mostly the body (face, eyes and brows, mouth and teeth, skin, frame, signs of age), then habits, wear and what they carry, and rarely a mark (scars, moles, birthmarks, tattoos). A roll picks a group by its weight, then a detail in it. In each group 'any' fits every era, 'modern' the present day and the future, 'period' the past and fantasy. A detail can say who it fits: 'skin' (a set below), 'build' (Companion's slender, middle or heavier, dating.BUILD_GROUPS), 'min_age' and 'max_age', and 'who' (woman, man, nonbinary); one whose condition is not known for them is not rolled.
